name: Pi-hole
description: Blocks ads and trackers for every device of your network, as its DNS server.

settings.label: DNS address
settings.hint: The NAS address Pi-hole answers DNS on: give this one to your router or devices. Keep it static.

settings.label: HTTPS
settings.hint: Serves the web interface over HTTPS with FreedomNAS's own certificate, the one of its web interface.

note: Answers DNS on port 53 of the NAS's address. Give that address as DNS server in your router, or on each device; the NAS needs a static address. With HTTPS on, the web interface uses the certificate FreedomNAS signs: install FreedomNAS's certificate authority once (System → Certificate) and open it by the NAS's hostname or address. While the reverse proxy serves the sites by name, Pi-hole answers every name under <hostname>.home.arpa (and under your own domain, when it has one) with the NAS's address by itself.

local_dns.header: # FreedomNAS: every name under these domains is this NAS, where the reverse proxy serves its sites by name
local_dns.off: # FreedomNAS: the reverse proxy serves no sites by name
